current_point.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用领导-工作者模式，结合基于边分割的图流划分与图摘要小批量训练，并通过注意力层汇总梯度，加速大规模图流数据的GNN训练并提升链路预测性能。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed DSGNN, a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode, combines edge-partition-based graph streaming partitioning with graph summarization based mini-batch training, and aggregates gradients through an attention layer, accelerating GNN training on large-scale graph streaming data and improving link prediction performance.
source_locations: 正文：DSGNN 模型的分布式训练流程
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者工作模式进行分布式训练
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点并计算梯度
根据梯度同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Adopt a leader-worker mode for distributed training
Leader partitions the original graph using an edge-segmentation-based graph streaming partitioning algorithm
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer for gradient computation
Synchronously update models on all computing nodes according to the gradient
